The keywords of each emoji, one row per keyword

Source: R/emoji-catalogue.R
emoji_keywords.Rd

emoji_keywords() returns the CLDR keywords attached to each glyph in long form, one row per (glyph, keyword) pair, which is the shape a join, a count or a word cloud wants. emoji_search() reads the same keywords and returns them collapsed into one string per match.

Usage

emoji_keywords(x = NULL)

Arguments

x

A character vector of glyphs. The default, NULL, returns every emoji in the catalogue, each under its canonical spelling.

Value

A tibble with columns emoji, name and keyword, one row per keyword, in the order of x and then of the keyword set.

Details

These are the English keyword sets, from the emoji package, and nothing in them says anything about how an emoji is read in another language or culture. Multilingual keywords are not bundled.

The keywords come from emoji while the catalogue comes from Unicode, and the two are not equally current: an emoji newer than emoji's own table (every Emoji 17.0 and 18.0 addition, at the time of writing) is detected and named but has no keywords. Such a glyph, and any string that is not an emoji at all, gets one row with keyword = NA, never a row with an empty string, so is.na(keyword) is the test for "no vocabulary".

Keywords belong to the emoji, not to one spelling of it, so the bare and the qualified heart return the same set.

See also

emoji_find() to go the other way, from keywords to emoji; emoji_search() for a substring search over keywords, names and shortcodes.

Examples

emoji_keywords(c("\U0001f389", "\u2764"))
#> # A tibble: 14 × 3
#>    emoji name         keyword    
#>    <chr> <chr>        <chr>      
#>  1 🎉    party popper awesome    
#>  2 🎉    party popper birthday   
#>  3 🎉    party popper celebrate  
#>  4 🎉    party popper celebration
#>  5 🎉    party popper excited    
#>  6 🎉    party popper hooray     
#>  7 🎉    party popper party      
#>  8 🎉    party popper popper     
#>  9 🎉    party popper tada       
#> 10 🎉    party popper woohoo     
#> 11 ❤     red heart    love       
#> 12 ❤     red heart    emotion    
#> 13 ❤     red heart    heart      
#> 14 ❤     red heart    red
